title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 374 (Obligations of companies registering under this Part)

content.overview: Every company registering under this Part shall, at the time of registration, deliver to the Registrar the documents and information prescribed for registration of companies under Chapter II, adapted as necessary, and shall comply with the other obligations of this Part and the rules made thereunder.
content.glance: Companies registering under this Part must deliver prescribed incorporation documents and comply with Part obligations and rules.
